items.title: Bella Cornish Interview
items.q: Who, Miles? Yeah. So I used to play when the Depression was, but they didn't get as much music to play...

ctx.x: Did he still continue on playing in it?
Who, Miles? Yeah. So I used to play when the Depression was, but they didn't get as much music to play, you know, as they did before. But they'd get some, but not as half as much, you know.
I just wondered if he got a job with one of those government bands, you know.
